title: An item explicitly instructs 'read it at the oath-stone: north from Highward, then east at the Last Cairn,' and a quest names the same 'Last Cairn' destination, but no room by that name or description was ever reached despite full traversal of the Wardmoor moor grid (Cairn Field, Twin Ruts, Sedge Flat, Wet Hollow, the Watch Cairn) - the stated route dead-ends at the Lost Sentry's forced fight instead.
where: carried item 'the true founding record' flavor text; quest 'The Oath That Never Ended'
